description: This file defines a module for interacting with Android devices via ADB, including device management, shell command execution, and error handling.

classes.name: AndroidDevice
classes.description: Represents an Android device connected via ADB, providing methods to execute commands, transfer files, and manage device properties.

methods.name: get_devices
methods.description: Returns a list of connected device serial numbers.

methods.name: get_device
methods.description: Returns a unique AndroidDevice instance based on serial, environment variable, or single connected device.

methods.description: Splits a string into lines, handling different line endings.
